components.name: Generate Button
components.css: .ds-generate { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 6px; background: #0e0e10; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14.72px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(14,14,16,0.04); border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-generate:hover { background: #000000; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(14,14,16,0.06); }

components.name: Primary Generate Button
components.css: .ds-generate { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 6px; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14.72px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(14,14,16,0.04); border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-generate-primary { background: #ff4d2e; } .ds-generate-primary:hover { background: #d93c1f; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(14,14,16,0.06); }

narrative.overview: The design is sharp, high-contrast, and deliberately steps out of the way of the generated images. Every element is elegant, refined, and spacious, allowing the AI output to be the true hero. We explicitly avoid generic Bootstrap/Material layouts and overly technical or cluttered configurations.

rules.name: The Safelight Rule
rules.body: The primary accent is the only splash of color and is used sparingly. It appears only on primary actions and live/active states.

dos: Do let the generated images be the hero of the interface.
Do use Vibrant Tangerine (#ff4d2e) sparingly for primary actions.
Do maintain high contrast and keyboard navigation capabilities.
donts: Don't use a generic Bootstrap/Material admin dashboard layout.
Don't clutter the UI with overly technical sliders or unnecessary structural boxes.
